concept: A manifesto for offensive proof, told in strix's own alert-red-on-near-black console. The wordmark boots like the tool itself, the thesis names the lie every scanner tells, the loop diagram shows the argument as a system, the terminal shows a real validated finding, the fix scene lands the contrarian punch, the count-up proves the crowd already agrees, the close reframes the whole stance.
money_shot_note: The 29k count-up at scene 6 (~83% of runtime): the number is the crowd's verdict on the argument the video just made, so it gets the count-up, the hit, and the flash.
transition_strategy: fade-through with accelerating exits, chromatic tick on every cut, emphasize reserved for the fix punch and the count-up
music_direction: industrial-cinematic, electronic, dark factory-floor percussion, cuts snapped to onsets by beat_align
